title: 1801 Prairie's south pavilion stands where the 1911 map draws it
items: The south pavilion of the Kimball house on Prairie Avenue now stands about 10 cm out from the front, as the 1911 fire insurance map draws it. It used to stand 60 cm out. Its windows still sit in deep stone openings, which now run back into the house wall. The roof's gutter and eave now stop at the pavilion's sides instead of running behind it. Seen from where J. W. Taylor took his photograph of about 1895, the pavilion's south corner now sits about 30 px closer to where his photograph shows it. The map also shows that corner cut back at an angle, and that is next.
